headline: Wardens Take Weathered Expanse as Nevish Line Rekindles
war_summary: The map has shifted since our last edition. The Weathered Expanse, a contested ground mere hours ago, now stands wholly in Warden hands — seven bases under their flag, two in ruin — after forty-eight events in a day, with Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk the hardest-fought posts. The Nevish Line is tonight's live wire: nine flags changed hands in the past two hours, the last logged as this dispatch went to press, with Grief Mother, Mistle Shrine and Princefal bearing the brunt. Linn Mercy, silent at midday, has flared anew — thirty-six events in a day about Rotdust and Outwich Ranch, casualties running past seven hundred the hour apiece. Callahans Passage shows movement again around Crumbling Post, while Marban Hollow and Mooring County have raised no flags since midday, though their casualty rolls climb steadily. Elsewhere the fronts are quiet, save fresh flag work at Briar in Stlican Shelf. It is day 769 of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
